steps.step: QSF4 (statement) options ranked by cost: (1) more independent chains (parallel) where the projection has no sign problem and the noise is moderate; (2) HMC global updates (stabilised force exists, PF5) to cut the HS-field autocorrelation that freezes the translation sectors; (3) sector-biased sampling with weight |Tr[P_r X]| (64 traces per local update with split chains, ~x3-5 per sweep) where per-configuration |f_U| >> 1 shows that the |Tr X| ensemble undersamples the projected weight; (4) a second solver only if (2) and (3) fail
